scope: CPU-only arithmetic checks for regrouped public automorphism gadgets and a shared registered-level dispatcher.
checks: Regrouped 40-bit gadget rows and their automorphism exponent match the selected 20-bit encrypted rows byte for byte.
Direct RNS switching matches the independent digit-NTT backend for random, zero and centered-boundary inputs.
Small-ring gadget multiplication matches a coefficient schoolbook oracle for both primary widths.
The shared map dispatcher matches the independent backend at root and series levels, and rejects missing exponents or unsupported levels.
